summary.text: Pattie McCoy (Patricia McCoy) is a Republican state representative from Rutland-1 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2015, was elected House minority leader in November 2018, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Pattie McCoy assumed office in the Vermont House on January 7, 2015.

Ballotpedia lists her 2015 committee assignment as Human Services and her 2023-2024 assignments as the House Rules, House Transportation, House Sexual Harassment Prevention Panel and Judicial Rules committees.
Ballotpedia says she was elected House minority leader in November 2018.
